body.objective: After the standard action-derived Einstein-to-Weyl cyclic pushforward obstruction, classify the smallest explicit changes of pairing, auxiliary content or action that can remove the generic cohomology-inertia mismatch, and state the physical price of each change.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal RELATIVE_EINSTEIN_WEYL_CYCLIC_PUSHFORWARD_OBSTRUCTION certificate by exact hash. On the declared compact-product carriers, construct the complete product-equivariant real support-local family of nondegenerate odd-pairing deformations, cotangent auxiliary extensions and quadratic action counterterms capable of changing the induced generic q-primary inertia. Quotient by cyclic canonical transformations and exact current improvements already proved inert. Determine which candidates admit a chain-compatible cyclic inclusion/pushforward and whether they preserve the original Einstein-Maxwell action, Weyl-Maxwell equations, real structure, residual action and extra-p shell separation. Land either a minimal repaired relative complex with an explicit changed-theory label or a no-go for every deformation in the complete declared family. Supply exact inertia/rank/cohomology certificates, independent verification and mutations crossing every signature wall.
body.current_gate: minimal explicitly changed theory or pairing that repairs the standard-action cyclic-pushforward obstruction
body.forbid: no repaired pairing presented as the original action-derived pairing; no auxiliary rows without BV degree, representation and action origin; no mixing of unequal-frequency q and p shells in an equivariant map; no relative anomaly subtraction before a repaired cyclic pushforward exists; no Lorentzian causality, positivity, particle, scattering or unitarity promotion
activates: a well-defined relative QME route in an explicitly modified theory
an exact statement of the minimal price of cyclic Einstein-to-Weyl transport
Paper 12 comparison of strict and modified relative programmes
